recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中出現一團彼此黏聚（cohesive）的大型細胞，核大而圓、細胞質深藍帶小空泡，細胞間界線不清且互相擠壓，大小遠超過旁邊的顆粒球，提示非造血來源的轉移性癌細胞。
features: Cohesive three-dimensional cluster of large non-hematopoietic cells, many times larger than the adjacent neutrophil
High N:C ratio with large round-to-oval nuclei and nuclear crowding/molding
Finely granular chromatin with inconspicuous to small nucleoli
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with small cytoplasmic vacuoles and indistinct cell borders
Background of scattered granulocytes and degenerated red cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive cluster of large atypical cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round to oval nuclei with nuclear crowding, and deeply basophilic, focally vacuolated cytoplasm. The cells are markedly larger than adjacent granulocytes and form a tight syncytial aggregate, a feature not typical of hematopoietic cells. In a patient with known lung adenocarcinoma, the findings are consistent with metastatic adenocarcinoma involving the bone marrow; confirmation on trephine biopsy with immunohistochemistry (e.g., cytokeratin, TTF-1) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have single lobulated nuclei and abundant granular pink cytoplasm, not multiple discrete round nuclei in a cohesive sheet.
Osteoblasts are loosely arranged with eccentric nuclei and a pale perinuclear hof away from the nucleus, lacking the nuclear crowding and molding seen here.
Hematolymphoid cells are generally discohesive and form clumps only artifactually; cytokeratin positivity and CD45 negativity confirm carcinoma.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round cell tumor (e.g., small cell carcinoma, neuroblastoma)
ddx.vs: Small cell tumors show smaller cells with scant cytoplasm and prominent nuclear molding, whereas these cells have more abundant vacuolated cytoplasm favoring adenocarcinoma.
